notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only two undated tower lists and a park article were found; no build date, design, height, staffing or fire history. Two WebSearch calls and about eight page reads were used, over the per-tower budget, because the first pages gave no tower detail. Coordinates in the brief (48.33722, -88.90444) match to the arc-second the coordinates in the Wikipedia park infobox (48 20 14 N, 88 54 16 W), so they may be the park centre, not the tower; recheck before use. The brief's agency history (Department of Lands and Forests to 1972) and its 2009 date for the listing were not verified; the only agency wording found is the MNR statement. Worth a targeted search for an Ontario tower history or a Lakehead University Archives photo before any re-run. The Lakehead result was seen in search and not read.
